description: Cracked brown rock with flat faceted sides. Half the things that shed it were walking around a moment ago.
lore: Learn to read the flats and this stops being a rock worth four. Weather leaves a face rounded and evenly pitted. A hammer leaves a bruise with a centre to it. Teeth leave parallel scoring, wide-set, the same gauge every time, with a shallow dish where the tusk turned — and a stone scored like that is not a rock any more, it is a measurement of [[monsters/gray_brute|Gnashjaw]]'s jaw, taken by the jaw. The sorters pay eleven for a clean bite and twelve if the scoring runs off the edge, because that means the animal was working on something larger and did not finish. Nothing else on the bench triples in price for having been chewed. Everything else on the bench is a piece of a creature. This is a piece of what one did.
